baseline: cf45b6b6 (dev before live saves were coalesced), run from an exported copy of its src/ and rattish/
machine: The maintainer's Linux desktop, 16 threads, Python 3.14; each step really starts a shell
notes: Wall time of run_rattish_file for a count loop of 1,000 bash-command 'echo hi' steps (1,001 node runs) against a throwaway data folder. Run with RATICODE_AGENT_SLICE unset: inside a sandboxed Rem turn it wraps every step in systemd-run --user, which the sandbox can't reach, so every step fails. Before, every node event re-read and re-validated the whole record and rewrote it, so each step cost more than the last.
